Report_ID: Percentage of patients with ≥4 point reduction from baseline in SELENA-SLEDAI score at Week 52
Title: A pivotal phase III, randomised, placebo-controlled study of belimumab in patients with systemic lupus erythematosus located in China, Japan and South Korea
Author: Zhang et al.
Comment: Denominators for this endpoint (447 belimumab / 218 placebo) are those reported for the endpoint analysis and differ slightly from the mITT Ns (451/226). Paper reports an odds ratio from logistic regression; no risk ratio is reported, so RR fields left empty (event counts provided for pooling).; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Belimumab 10 mg/kg IV + standard of care') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: randomised double-blind placebo-controlled phase III trial (2:1)
Participant type: Adults ≥18 years with active, autoantibody-positive SLE (SELENA-SLEDAI ≥8) receiving standard of care
Recruitment source: 49 centres across China, Japan and South Korea (May 2011–September 2015)
Outcome measurement: Number/percentage of patients achieving ≥4 point reduction from baseline in SELENA-SLEDAI at Week 52 (mITT population)
Outcome variable: Percentage of patients with ≥4 point reduction from baseline in SELENA-SLEDAI score at Week 52

Report_ID: >=4-point reduction in SELENA-SLEDAI score at week 52
Title: Efficacy and Safety of Subcutaneous Belimumab in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: A Fifty-Two-Week Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study
Author: Stohl W, et al.
Comment: The planned outcome (dichotomous >=4-point SELENA-SLEDAI reduction at week 52) is reported ONLY graphically in Figure 2B; no numeric percentages or event counts for the SS component are stated anywhere in the text, tables, or figure legend. Only the arm denominators (556 belimumab, 280 placebo, ITT) and the direction/statistical significance ("All components of the SRI4 showed statistical significance at week 52") are verbatim. group_1_events/group_2_events therefore left empty rather than estimated from the figure. Row is not poolable as an RR without digitizing Figure 2B.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Belimumab 200 mg SC weekly + standard SLE therapy') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False); unsupported or insufficient statistic type
Country: Multinational (177 sites in 30 countries: North/Central/South America, Eastern and Western Europe, Australia, Asia)
Participant type: Adults (>=18 years) with moderate-to-severe, autoantibody-positive SLE (screening SELENA-SLEDAI >=8)
Recruitment source: 177 clinical trial sites in 30 countries, November 2011 to February 2015
Outcome measurement: Dichotomous responder status on the SELENA-SLEDAI component of the SRI4
Outcome variable: >=4-point reduction in SELENA-SLEDAI score at week 52

Title: A Phase 3, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Study of Belimumab, a Monoclonal Antibody That Inhibits BLyS, in Patients With Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (BLISS-76)
Author: Furie R, Petri M, Zamani O, et al. (BLISS-76 Study Group)
Comment: Belimumab 1 mg/kg arm (116/271) intentionally not extracted per synthesis plan (non-approved dose). Country: Europe and North/Central America (136 centers in 19 countries)
Participant type: Adults (≥18 years) with ANA- or anti-dsDNA-positive active SLE (SELENA-SLEDAI ≥ 6) on standard of care
Recruitment source: 136 clinical centers in 19 countries (Europe, North/Central America)
Outcome measurement: Number (%) of patients achieving ≥4-point reduction from baseline in SELENA-SLEDAI at week 52, modified intention-to-treat
Outcome variable: Patients with ≥4-point reduction in SELENA-SLEDAI score at week 52

Report_ID: Reduction ≥4 points in SELENA-SLEDAI at week 52
Title: Efficacy and safety of belimumab in patients with active systemic lupus erythematosus: a randomised, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial (BLISS-52)
Author: Navarra SV, et al. (BLISS-52 Study Group)
Comment: Paper reports adjusted odds ratios from logistic regression (adjusted for baseline randomisation stratification factors), not risk ratios; raw event counts extracted for RR pooling. Belimumab 1 mg/kg arm (153/288) deliberately not recorded per synthesis plan.; group_1/group_2 fields swapped: the extractor itself stated group_1_label ('Belimumab 10 mg/kg IV + standard of care') is the intervention arm (group_1_is_control=False)
Design Type: randomised controlled trial (three-arm, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3)
Country: Multinational (Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Australia, Hong Kong, India, Korea, Philippines, Taiwan, Romania, Russia)
Participant type: Adults (≥18 years) meeting ACR criteria for SLE, seropositive, SELENA-SLEDAI score ≥6
Recruitment source: 90 centres in 13 countries (Latin America, Asia-Pacific, eastern Europe)
Outcome measurement: Number (%) of patients in the modified intention-to-treat population achieving ≥4-point reduction in SELENA-SLEDAI score at week 52
Outcome variable: Reduction ≥4 points in SELENA-SLEDAI at week 52
